name: Docker in Docker
description: Installs a rootless Docker engine for building and running containers inside the dev container.

version.description: Engine channel (latest) or a version (major, major.minor or major.minor.patch).

buildxVersion.description: Buildx plugin channel (latest) or a version (major, major.minor or major.minor.patch).

composeVersion.description: Compose plugin channel (latest) or a version (major, major.minor or major.minor.patch).

stateDir.description: If set, puts this feature's data at this path, which must be inside the remote user's home. Mount a volume there to persist it across rebuilds. Holds the Docker CLI config, including docker login credentials, which are stored in plain text without a credential helper.

daemonJson.description: Daemon settings as JSON with backslash-escaped quotes, written to daemon.json.
